videos.desc: In a cartoon mountain cabin, a man sits at a table holding his aching head. His friend hands him a small white pill and pours a glass of water; he swallows the pill, drinks, and soon smiles feeling better.

From a street cafe a man shields his eyes and watches an ambulance drive up a pastel-colored street and pull over; two paramedics in high-vis uniforms climb out with a red medical bag and stride off toward their call.
On the bench of a sports hall, a physio wraps an elastic bandage around a handball player's wrist and hand, fixes the end, and the player flexes her wrist and gives a thumbs up and a smile.

A woman wrapped in blankets sits on an armchair coughing and holding her scratchy throat; her partner brings her a steaming mug of honey-lemon tea, she sips it carefully and finally smiles with a thumbs up as a cat jumps on her lap.

On a moving train a young woman pumps clear gel from a small bottle into her palm, rubs her hands, then gives one pump to her seatmate; with clean hands the two happily share samosas from a tin and sip tea.
videos.said: One pump each. Rub, rub, rub. Mmm.

videos.desc: A barefoot young man carrying a laundry basket stubs his toe on a metal bed frame, drops the laundry, cries out and sits on the floor clutching his hurt foot.

A red-haired woman winces and shows a cut finger in a kitchen; a man opens a small first-aid tin, peels the backing off an adhesive plaster, wraps it around her fingertip and playfully blows on the bandaged finger.
videos.said: Ow! Tiny cut! I've got this. All wrapped up.

videos.desc: A young woman wrapped in a blanket sits on a sofa blowing her nose into tissues and rubbing her aching head; a man brings her a steaming mug of tea, tucks a blanket around her, and she sips it looking miserable.

In a hand-painted anime meadow, a young man holding a big bouquet of dandelions builds up to an enormous sneeze that blows his straw hat off and scatters dandelion seeds everywhere, while a girl beside him first ducks, then giggles as he wipes his nose with a handkerchief.

At a flower market, a young woman smells the tulip bouquet her boyfriend gave her and keeps sneezing into her elbow while he laughs; moments later he catches it too and sneezes himself, leaving both of them laughing among the flower stalls.

A sunny narrow street of old apartment buildings with wrought-iron balconies. A white emergency vehicle marked with orange stripes and blue star-of-life symbols is parked at the kerb with its blue lights flashing. The camera moves in on the bonnet and windscreen, then two crew members in yellow high-visibility jackets walk across the road carrying a red bag toward a cafe terrace where people sit at tables.

In a clinic a woman in blue scrubs winds a long white cloth strip around a man's hand and wrist, pulling it tight in overlapping turns; more rolls of the same white strip sit on the counter behind. The camera pulls back and the joke lands: colleagues have wound the strip round and round his whole body and head until only his face shows, and everyone is laughing while two more people keep unrolling.

A student sits at a desk in front of a laptop and a stack of textbooks when he feels something on his upper lip and finds his nose is bleeding. He grabs a tissue and presses it to his nostrils, tipping his head. A friend comes over, pulls more tissues from the box on the desk and hands them to him, staying beside him while he holds them to his nose; the used tissues in the box are spotted with blood.

A young footballer in a white and blue striped shirt sits on a bench in a changing room with his leg pulled up. Low on his shin is a big dark purple mark, and he screws up his face and sucks in his breath as he touches it. A team-mate crouches beside him, points at the mark and winces too, then hands him a blue ice pack. The player presses the ice pack against his shin, flinches and grits his teeth, then holds it there and breathes out slowly while the pain settles.

At a pavement cafe a young man in an olive T-shirt takes a bite of a croissant and it goes down the wrong way: his eyes go wide, he grabs his throat and cannot breathe. The woman next to him jumps up, gets behind him, wraps her arms round his middle and pulls sharply in and up several times while he bends forward over the table. It comes up, he sits back gasping and coughing, and she keeps one hand on his shoulder and holds a glass of water to his mouth while he drinks. Other diners and a waiter look over.

A reading room in a library, with tall wooden shelves of books and other students working at the tables behind. A young woman in a beige cardigan sits at a table with an open book, a pen, her glasses and a water bottle in front of her. She presses her hand over her mouth, her eyes watering and her face screwed up, then bends forward over the table and coughs hard into her fist and into the crook of her sleeve, several times. The students behind her keep reading.

A young man in a navy tracksuit walks down a long, bright hospital corridor on two metal crutches, with a grey walking boot strapped onto one foot. He swings himself forward step by step towards the camera. Behind him a nurse in white scrubs follows with a clipboard, watching him walk. Windows line one wall and handrails run along both sides of the corridor.

A free health check under a white gazebo at a school fair. A young woman in a white nurse's tunic leans over a seated young man and shines a small lit instrument into his ear. He tips his head back, opens his mouth wide and she presses his tongue down with a wooden stick and looks into his throat. She then straps a blue blood pressure cuff around his upper arm and listens while he sits still and smiles. Other students queue behind the table, watching and giving a thumbs up.
videos.said: Look up, say uh-uh. - Uh. - All good?

videos.desc: A young woman lies ill on a sofa under a thick grey blanket in a lamp-lit living room, her face flushed red and a thermometer in her mouth. An older woman sits beside her, holds the thermometer steady and reads a second one, frowning at the number. She puts a hand on the young woman's forehead to feel how hot she is, then lays a folded damp cloth across it and smooths it into place, staying at her side the whole time.

In a bright dental surgery a woman in teal scrubs reaches up and swings the big round examination lamp over a man lying back in the treatment chair. Wearing latex gloves she leans over him with a small round mouth mirror and looks at his teeth while he keeps his mouth open. A close-up shows a toothbrush with blue bristles brushing along his front teeth. She then holds a round hand mirror up so he can see, and finishes by giving a thumbs-up next to the mirror.

On a hilltop above green fields under a clear blue sky a woman tilts her head back, closes her eyes and breathes in deeply; a man holds a mug of coffee under his nose and breathes in the steam; a woman with curly hair pushes her nose into a bunch of bright flowers; a man leans open-mouthed over a fresh loaf of bread; finally a group of friends stands in a circle with their arms spread wide, heads back, all taking a deep breath together.

A young woman in a grey hoodie sits at a kitchen table with a box of tablets, an open pill case, a glass of water and a brown medicine bottle in front of her. She pours the brown syrup onto a spoon, swallows it, screws up her face in disgust and sticks out her tongue, gulps down the water, shudders, and finally screws the cap back on the bottle.

In a bright consulting room a woman in a teal polo shirt and glasses sets bowls of food down on a wooden table in front of a young man in a yellow t-shirt: a bowl of spinach, tomatoes and a yellow pepper, a bowl of brown rice, a grilled fish on a plate, a bowl of mixed nuts and a tall glass of milk. A food pyramid poster hangs on the wall behind them. She points at the food and talks him through it; he leans in, looks at each dish and nods, and she puts a hand on his shoulder as they finish.

In a bright living room a young man in a grey tracksuit bangs his leg on the corner of the sofa. He throws his head back with his mouth wide open, hops on one foot into the hallway, doubles over and clutches his shin with both hands. He slides down the wall by the doorframe, sits on the floor with his face screwed up and keeps holding the sore leg.

In a bright surgery, a man in a white coat examines a young man in a checked shirt sitting on the examination couch. He holds the patient's mouth open and looks down his throat, then listens to his back with a stethoscope, then wraps a blue blood-pressure cuff around his upper arm. He gives a thumbs up; the young man laughs and flexes his bicep, and the doctor hands him a small colourful card.

A young man with a red, sore nose stands at a lit pharmacy window under a green cross sign while a hand behind the glass passes him a small box of medicine. He then waits inside a modern pharmacy under a red digital queue-number display, carrying a paper bag, and pays at a self-service terminal. Finally he stands open-mouthed inside a grand old pharmacy whose walls are floor-to-ceiling wooden drawers, watching a pharmacist in a white coat climb a tall wooden ladder to fetch something from the top row.

A young woman in a yellow dress stands in a huge summer meadow full of yellow, white and blue wildflowers. She sneezes hard into her cupped hands, screws her eyes shut, wipes under her nose and presses a hand to her chest with a miserable, streaming-eyed face while the pollen-heavy field goes on around her and other people wander through the flowers in the background.

On the wet wooden deck of a fishing boat in a rough grey sea, a man with very short hair in a yellow oilskin jacket and trousers grips the metal rail with one hand and presses his fist to his chest, bent forward with a pale, screwed-up face. He straightens up, opens his mouth wide and heaves as if about to throw up, then leans on the rail again, cheeks puffed. White-capped waves crash around the boat under heavy clouds. Coiled ropes, a life ring and green nets lie on the deck.

A young woman in a cream puffer jacket, a mustard scarf and a dark red beanie stands in the middle of a crowded tram on a winter evening. With her eyes shut she holds a tissue to her nose with gloved hands, sneezing and wiping her nose. A thermos flask and a bag with a baguette hang from her arms. Around her, a young man pulls his scarf over his nose, a young woman holds out a packet of tissues, and another passenger frowns, while a young man in front reads a book. Snow is visible through the windows.

A messy hotel room the morning after a party, with sunlight coming through white curtains. A young woman with red hair, a gold sequin dress and smudged make-up lies on the carpet and stretches her arm out towards a glass of water on a low table, grabs it and rolls onto her side holding it. A paper party hat lies next to her. Confetti, playing cards, banknotes, silver trays and bottles cover the floor, and a man in a white shirt and tie sleeps on the sofa behind her.

An old-fashioned optician's room with wooden panelling and a green and white checked floor. A young woman with long wavy blonde hair, in a lilac jumper, sits in a leather examination chair wearing round metal test glasses. Her mouth is open in delight as she points at a small blue and yellow bird on a branch of red berries outside the window; the bird flies away and she keeps pointing and smiling. A man in a white shirt stands beside her holding a small lens and smiles.
